entries.message: Fix - Improve media review, mobile controls, and tracker privacy
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fix: Improve media review, mobile controls, and tracker privacy
Fix: Keep watched items and dismissed title-only movie matches out of Manual Watch review.
Fix: Improve mobile media and Upcoming layouts with inline season actions, shared controls, and clearer TV show summaries.
Fix: Refresh stale Now Playing data when returning to suspended pages.
Fix: Route tracker scripts and events through first-party website and demo endpoints while honoring DNT and GPC.
Fix: Restore locked-login centering and bundled TVDB demo metadata, with refreshed release documentation and captures.
Fix: Block release publication when unresolved high-severity CodeQL findings remain.
